description: Overall health, energy for sport, brain, kidneys, liver and longevity. Built from his March 2026 bloods + hair test. No zinc (hair zinc high, copper low). No iodine/ashwagandha (thyroid runs high). No NSAIDs. Add one new item every 3–4 days. Retest at 3 months: kidney, liver, full blood count, hs-CRP, homocysteine, TSH.

supplements.name: High-Polyphenol Olive Oil
supplements.boost: Raw, on food. Doubles as the fat that the fat-soluble supplements need
supplements.foodInteractions: Replace other fats, don't add on top (~240 kcal). Keep dark and cool, finish within 1–2 months of opening
supplements.notes: Heart, brain, blood pressure, oxidised LDL

supplements.name: CoQ10 (Ubiquinol)
supplements.boost: Ubiquinol form. Take with olive oil / fatty breakfast
supplements.notes: Mitochondrial energy, heart. Levels fall after 50

supplements.name: Astaxanthin
supplements.notes: Antioxidant, skin, eyes, recovery. Mild blood-thinning: stop 7–10 days before surgery/tooth extraction

supplements.name: Curcumin Phytosome
supplements.boost: Phytosome form. NO black pepper/piperine (slows bilirubin clearance in Gilbert's)
supplements.notes: Inflammation, joints, brain. Mild blood-thinning: caution with aspirin/blood thinners, stop before surgery

supplements.name: Black Seed Oil
supplements.notes: Inflammation, joints, blood sugar and BP support. Mild blood-thinning

supplements.name: Vitamin D3 + K2 MK-7
supplements.boost: Maintenance only — his D was ~102 nmol/L. Don't megadose
supplements.notes: Immune, bones, muscle. No K2 if ever on warfarin

supplements.name: Sulforaphane (Broccoli Sprout)
supplements.foodInteractions: Not with very hot drinks — heat kills the activating enzyme
supplements.notes: Detox and antioxidant defences, liver, offsets smoking damage

supplements.name: Astragalus
supplements.notes: Kidney protection, immune support. Caution with immunosuppressants, lithium

supplements.name: NMN (Liposomal)
supplements.notes: NAD+ precursor. Longevity, energy (evidence still weak)

supplements.name: Magnesium Malate
supplements.boost: Daytime 'energy' magnesium. Keep ALL magnesium forms ≤350 mg elemental/day total
supplements.foodInteractions: 2 h apart from thyroid pills or antibiotics
supplements.notes: Hair magnesium low, serum low-normal. Energy, muscles

supplements.name: Collagen + Hyaluronic Acid + Keratin
supplements.boost: 30–60 min before training, with vitamin C (acerola). Any time on rest days

supplements.name: NAC (N-Acetyl Cysteine)
supplements.boost: Take together with glycine (GlyNAC). Move to dinner if it upsets his stomach
supplements.notes: Glutathione, liver, helps clear mercury, protects lungs

supplements.name: Taurine
supplements.notes: Heart, muscles, recovery, longevity amino acid

supplements.name: Magnesium Taurate
supplements.boost: Counts toward the ≤350 mg/day magnesium total

supplements.name: Magnesium Threonate
supplements.boost: Brain magnesium — evening, not morning. Counts toward the ≤350 mg total
